$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion.

state.description: State directory. Default .changeharbor next to this file. Overridden by CHANGEHARBOR_STATE or --state.

github_secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub webhook secret.

gitlab_secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitLab webhook token.

models.description: Named model configs: a file path (JSON, or YAML when it ends in .yaml or .yml) or an inline mapping, e.g. {"default": "models/review.json"}.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the API key.

api_key_header.description: Header carrying the API key, when not the API's default.

api_key_prefix.description: Prefix before the key in the header; "" for none.

structured_output.description: Whether the API enforces a JSON schema. Must be true.

pricing_known.description: Whether the prices below are known.

input_price_micros_per_million.description: Input price in micro-units per million tokens.

output_price_micros_per_million.description: Output price in micro-units per million tokens.

timeout.description: Request timeout: a duration such as 3m, or integer nanoseconds.

max_cost_micros.description: Cost budget per review in micro-units; 0 means no known allowance.

defaults.description: Values every repository inherits: the repository keys except those that identify one repository (url, provider, api_url, fork_source, branch, mirror.path, mirror.url, auth.bot_user_id, auth.bot_username, auth.github_app.installation_id). Mappings merge; a repository's scalars and lists replace inherited ones.

auth.description: Credentials and bot identity every repository inherits. auth.github_app applies only to GitHub repositories and auth.token_scheme only to GitLab ones, so defaults may set both auth.token_env and auth.github_app: GitHub repositories use the App, GitLab repositories the token.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the forge token. A GitHub repository uses it only when no auth.github_app is set or inherited.

token_scheme.description: GitLab only. How the token is sent. Default private-token.

github_app.description: Authenticate GitHub repositories as a GitHub App; GitLab repositories don't inherit it. A repository that sets auth.token_env drops it.

private_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the App's PEM private key.

mirror.description: Local git mirror reviewd reads source from.

sync.description: auto (fetch from origin when configured), none, or a configured remote name. Default auto.

auth.description: none (credentials come from the mirror's own git config) or token (pass the forge token to git through the environment; requires sync auto). Default token for a GitHub App with sync auto, else none.

policy.description: Merge risk policy: a file path (JSON, or YAML when it ends in .yaml or .yml) or an inline mapping.

oneOf.description: Inline merge risk policy (the flat policy fields).

base_minimum.description: Lowest risk score any change gets (1-10).

auto_approve_max.description: Highest risk score that may be approved automatically (1-10).

required_checks.description: Checks that must pass before approval.

required_human_requirements.description: Human sign-offs that must be present before approval.

at_least.description: Applies at or above this size.

unknown_size.description: What to do when the size of a change is unknown.

minimum.description: Minimum risk score (1-10) for action minimum.

at_most_prior_merges.description: Applies at or below this many prior merges.

unknown_familiarity.description: What to do when familiarity is unknown.

minimum.description: Minimum risk score (1-10) for action minimum.

otherwise_minimum.description: Risk floor when no tier applies.

model.description: Name of a model in models. Default: default, when defined.

response.description: Offline model response fixture (testing). Mutually exclusive with model.

publish.description: What reviewd may write to the forge.

approvals.description: off, shadow (evaluate everything, write nothing) or submit. Default shadow.

comments.description: off, shadow (render only) or post. Default shadow.

protections.description: required (default): approve only when the forge's own protections are in place. advisory: approve regardless of protection settings; doctor reports gaps as warnings. Must be set explicitly.

inline_comments.description: off, shadow (plan only, no remote calls) or post (one comment per anchored finding on its changed line; findings no longer reported are marked possibly outdated). Default shadow.

suggestions.description: include (default): add a committable suggestion block to inline comments when the model proposes a replacement for changed lines. off: never include one.

inline_min_severity.description: Lowest finding severity posted as an inline comment. Default low: info findings stay in the summary only.

ci_trust.description: How the head pipeline's definition is trusted. Default external_config.

ci_paths.description: With unchanged_config: globs of files that define job behaviour.

required_jobs.description: Job names that must succeed. Default: the policy's required_checks.

required_checks.description: Check name to trusted GitHub App ID.

model.description: Name of a model in models.

review.description: Trusted review guidance and path filters. Comes only from this file, never from the repository under review. Changing it invalidates existing reviews.

instructions.description: Repository-wide review instructions added to every review prompt.

path_instructions.description: Instructions added only when a changed file (old or new path) matches one of the globs.

paths.description: Globs: * within a segment, ? one character, ** whole segments.

exclude.description: Globs of files left out of the model's input (generated, vendored, lockfiles). Risk-policy minimums still count them.

large_changes.description: What to do when the diff doesn't fit the model's request budget: incomplete posts a status comment and reviews nothing; partial reviews the whole files that fit and lists the rest. Partial reviews are never approved. Changing it invalidates existing reviews.

triggers.description: Which changes the service reviews automatically. Does not affect `reviewd review --url` or the review comment command, and does not invalidate reviews.

drafts.description: Whether draft pull or merge requests are reviewed automatically.

ignore_authors.description: Author logins or usernames not reviewed automatically. * matches any run of characters; matching ignores case.

skip_labels.description: Label names (case-insensitive) that skip automatic review.

skip_title_keywords.description: Case-insensitive title substrings that skip automatic review.

additionalProperties.description: A repository reviewd serves, keyed by a short lowercase name.

url.description: Web URL of the repository, e.g. https://gitlab.com/group/app. Provider, web and API bases and path are derived from it.

provider.description: github or gitlab. Required only for self-managed hosts.

api_url.description: API base override, e.g. for a GitLab installed under a path prefix.

auth.description: Credentials and bot identity. Set exactly one of auth.token_env and auth.github_app.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the forge token. Set exactly one of auth.token_env and auth.github_app.

token_scheme.description: GitLab only. How the token is sent. Default private-token.

github_app.description: Authenticate as a GitHub App. Set exactly one of auth.token_env and auth.github_app. GitHub repositories only. app_id and private_key_env are required, here or inherited from defaults.

private_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the App's PEM private key.

installation_id.description: Numeric installation ID. Default: resolved by reviewd config resolve.

bot_user_id.description: Numeric user ID the token acts as. Resolved from /user when omitted; for a GitHub App, resolved as the App bot user.

bot_username.description: Username the token acts as, used for the `@username review` comment command and the retry hint in status comments. Resolved from /user when omitted; set it for GitHub App tokens (app-slug[bot]).

token_env.description: Deprecated: use auth.token_env. Environment variable holding the forge token. Set exactly one of token_env and github.app.

token_scheme.description: Deprecated: use auth.token_scheme. GitLab only. How the token is sent. Default private-token.

bot_user_id.description: Deprecated: use auth.bot_user_id. Numeric user ID the token acts as. Resolved from /user when omitted; for a GitHub App, resolved as the App bot user.

mirror.description: Local git mirror reviewd reads source from.
